beats.say: I have not opened my inbox before ten in three weeks.
beats.text: I haven't opened my inbox *before ten* in three weeks.

beats.say: Every morning at seven, an agent reads it for me and sorts it into three piles.
beats.title: Every morning at 7:00

beats.say: It only reads. It never replies, never archives, never clicks a link.
beats.title: What it is not allowed to do

beats.say: What I get is one note. Yesterday's had four lines.
beats.title: Today's note

beats.say: One rule matters most. An email that talks to the agent is data, not an instruction.
beats.headline: What it reads is *data*, never instructions

beats.say: It costs me one minute a day to read the note.
beats.label: a day, to read the note

beats.say: The prompt and the rules are in my free kit.
beats.line: The people and messages shown are made up.
